rows.estimand: Does sustained distance from the proposed thermal reference dull sensitivity?

estimate.units: change in sensation-per-degree slope per outdoor-distance degree

rows.control_status: passes numerical known answers; minimum-effect sensitivity separate
rows.strongest_rival: Thermal history, personal control and cohort selection are confounded
rows.warrant: Frozen design, complete cluster refits and independent replay
rows.public_wording: The registered negative relation between thermal sensitivity and distance from 22 degrees is inconclusive; the observational comparison does not establish dulling.

rows.estimand: Conditional sensitivity of the original thermal-distance contrast at its fixed practical bar
rows.control_status: Numerical checks pass; conditional sensitivity limited
rows.strongest_rival: Conditional sign-symmetric residual construction is not population power or evidence of absence
rows.scope: Constructed outcomes conditional on observed ASHRAE building summaries

scope_qualifiers.corpus: ASHRAE Global Thermal Comfort Database II
scope_qualifiers.population: 213 eligible buildings, 51 analytic weather-linked naturally ventilated buildings
scope_qualifiers.substrate: Constructed outcomes on a human observational design; exact program readout

rows.warrant: Both full constructed controls, actual native pilot/continuation and complete independent replay
rows.public_wording: Under the fixed observed building design, the thermal-distance comparison has limited sensitivity at the registered practical effect; the inconclusive human primary cannot establish absence.
